notes: Three fixes from the three-bot gate (2026-11-08): (1) the spoken serial number now speaks its letters (ZY22ABC123 is read out in full - before, the letters were dropped and only the digits were spoken); (2) when two phones are plugged in, the screen now says so and names that the first one is being shown; (3) the update door now refuses any update whose fingerprint is missing from the manifest instead of installing it unchecked. Face unchanged: MODEL NUMBER + IMEI only. Carries the v1.14 readable CHECK FOR UPDATES button, the v1.13 two-field face, the v1.12 three-road updater and the v1.11 tools self-heal.
